NONE: › to treat with light or other types of radiation
（用光或其他輻射）照射

example: The cells are irradiated so that they cannot reproduce.
這些細胞被射線照射後不能再繁殖。

NONE: › light or other types of radiation used in order to treat or diagnose a medical condition
（用來治療或診斷用的）光（或其他輻射）

example: X-rays are a form of irradiation.
X光是一種輻射。

NONE: C2 not using reason or clear thinking
不理智的，沒有理性的

example: It's totally irrational, but I'm frightened of mice.
這很荒唐，但我的確害怕老鼠。
His parents were worried by his increasingly irrational behaviour.
他的父母因他的行為越來越乖僻而擔憂。

NONE: › a number that cannot be expressed as the ratio of two whole numbers
無理數

example: Compare
rational number

NONE: › impossible to find agreement between or with, or impossible to deal with
不可調和的；難以應付的

example: They have become irreconcilable, with both sides refusing to compromise any further.
他們雙方都拒絕進一步妥協，和解已經不可能了。

NONE: › impossible to get back
無法挽回的
› impossible to correct, improve, or change
無法改正的；無法改進的；無法改變的

example: There are irredeemable flaws in the logic of the argument.
這些論點的邏輯存在無法彌補的漏洞。

NONE: › impossible to make smaller or simpler
不能減縮的；不可簡化的

example: A few simple shapes are the irreducible forms from which all of the patterns are generated.
一些簡單的形狀不可簡化，所有圖案都是由這些形狀構成的。

NONE: › impossible to prove wrong
無可辯駁的，無可否認的

example: an irrefutable argument
無可辯駁的論證

NONE: › despite; not being affected by something
不管，儘管

example: I don't think children should be hit, irregardless of what they've done wrong.
我認為不管孩子做錯了甚麼，都不應該打他們。

NONE: › formal (of behaviour or actions) not according to usual rules or what is expected
（行為）不合常規的，不正常的
B1 specialized language An irregular verb, noun, adjective, etc. does not obey the usual rules for words in the language.
（動詞、名詞、形容詞等）不規則變化的
B2 not regular in shape or form; having parts of different shapes or sizes
不規則的；不整齊的
B2 not happening at regular times or not with regular spaces in between
不定期的；無規律的
› US informal not emptying your bowels as often as you would usually
便秘的
› (of a soldier) fighting for a country but not as a member of its official army
非正規軍的
› a soldier who is not a member of the official army of a country
非正規軍人

example: Releasing the goods without an invoice is most irregular.
沒有發貨清單就發貨是最不符合規範的。
an irregular coastline
彎彎曲曲的海岸線
an irregular heartbeat
心律不整
They met at irregular intervals.
他們不定期會面。

C or U: › [ C or U ] the quality of not being regular in shape or form, or an example of this
› [ C or U ] something that is not correct or acceptable

U: › [ U ] the fact that something does not happen at regular times

example: The pictures showed cracks and other irregularities in otherwise perfectly regular crystals.
從這些圖片可見：除了一些裂縫及凹凸不平之處，這些等軸晶系晶體無可挑剔。
The west of the island is famous for the irregularity of its coastline.
島的西部因其曲折的海岸線而聞名。
The inspectors found several irregularities in the business accounts.
檢查人員在業務賬目中發現了幾處違規。
The irregularity of (= the lack of rules for) English spelling means that it is easy to make mistakes.
英語拼寫沒有規律可循意味著很容易拼錯。

NONE: › the fact that something is not related to what is being discussed or considered and therefore not important, or an example of this
不相關，不切題

example: Sympathy is an irrelevance - we need practical help.
同情無濟於事——我們需要實際的幫助。
Many of these problems may simply fade into irrelevance when the new rules come into force.
一旦新規則開始實施，這些問題大多可能就會變得無關緊要了。

NONE: › not related to what is being discussed or considered and therefore not important
不相關的，不切題的

example: These documents are largely irrelevant to the present investigation.
這些文件與目前的調查幾乎毫不相干。
Making a large profit is irrelevant to us - the important thing is to make the book available to the largest possible audience.
賺取巨額利潤對我們來說並不重要，重要的是要讓儘可能多的讀者讀到這本書。

NONE: › having no interest in religion, or generally opposed to religion
無宗教信仰的；反對宗教的
› impossible to correct or cure
不能改正的，無可救藥的

example: The merits of this plan outweighed several obvious flaws in it, which were irremediable.
這個計劃的優點大於其中幾個無法補救的明顯缺陷。

NONE: › impossible to repair or make right again
不能修復的，無可挽救的

example: Unless the oil spill is contained, irreparable damage will be done to the coastline.
除非石油洩漏受到控制，否則會對海岸線造成無可補救的破壞。

NONE: › too special, unusual, or valuable to replace with something or someone else
不可替代的，獨一無二的

example: Most of the porcelain you see in the display cabinets is irreplaceable.
你在陳列櫃中所見到的瓷器大多是獨一無二的。
No one's irreplaceable in the workplace.
職場上沒有人是無法替代的。

NONE: › full of energy and enthusiasm; impossible to stop
狂熱的；抑制不住的

example: Even the rain failed to dampen his irrepressible spirits.
即使下雨也未能澆滅他那高漲的熱情。

NONE: › without fault and therefore impossible to criticize
無可指責的，無瑕疵的

example: Her conduct throughout was irreproachable.
她的表現自始至終無可挑剔。

NONE: C2 impossible to refuse, oppose, or avoid because it is too pleasant, attractive, or strong
不可抗拒的，無法抵擋的

example: an irresistible offer
無法拒絕的提議
She gave me one of those irresistible smiles and I just had to agree.
她對我那莞爾一笑真是令人無法抗拒，我只好同意了。

NONE: › not able or willing to take decisions or actions
猶豫不決的，優柔寡斷的

example: an irresolute reply
猶豫不決的回答

NONE: C2 without considering; not needing to allow for
不考慮地，不顧地

example: The legislation must be applied irrespective of someone's ethnic origins.
這項法律不分族裔，適用於所有人。

NONE: B2 not thinking enough or not worrying about the possible results of what you do
不負責任的，無責任感的

example: [ + to infinitive ] It would be irresponsible to ignore these warnings.
無視這些警告是不負責任的。

NONE: › impossible to correct or return to a previously existing situation or condition
無法糾正的，不能恢復的，無法挽救的

example: I agree things look difficult, but the situation is far from irretrievable.
我承認情況看起來不妙，但還遠遠沒到無法挽救的地步。
The couple separated on the grounds of irretrievable breakdown (of their marriage).
這對夫妻因（婚姻）關係破裂無法挽回而分居。

NONE: › not showing the expected respect for official, important, or holy things
不尊敬的，無禮的

example: an irreverent comment/approach/attitude
無禮的批評／方式／態度

NONE: C2 not possible to change; impossible to return to a previous condition
不可改變的，不可逆轉的

example: Smoking has caused irreversible damage to his lungs.
吸煙已經對他的肺部造成了永久的損害。

NONE: › impossible to change
不可改變的

example: an irrevocable decision
不可改變的決定

T: › to supply land with water so that crops and plants will grow
› specialized medical to wash an injured part of a person's body, especially a cut, with a flow of liquid

example: irrigated land/fields
經灌溉的土地/田野

NONE: C2 becoming annoyed very easily
易怒的，暴躁的

example: Be careful what you say - he's rather irritable today.
說話小心點——他今天脾氣很大。

「不要再打擾我，」她煩躁地說。

NONE: › a condition that affects the bowels and causes stomach pain, and is often caused by worry or anxiety
腸易激綜合症，腸激躁症（常由焦慮引起，表現為腹痛）

C: › something that causes trouble or makes you annoyed
令人煩惱的事物；造成麻煩的事物
› a substance that makes part of your body sore or painful

example: The report is bound to add a new irritant to international relations.
這份報告肯定會給國際關係添加新麻煩。

花粉有刺激性，會使過敏的人眼睛紅腫疼痛。

T: C1 to make someone angry or annoyed
› to make a part of your body sore or painful

example: After a while her behaviour really began to irritate me.
過了一會兒兒，她的行為真讓我惱火了。
At first my contact lenses irritated my eyes.
起初一戴上隱形眼鏡，我的眼睛就痛。

NONE: B2 annoyed
被激怒的，惱火的

example: I began to get increasingly irritated by/at her questions.
本開始被她的問題弄得越來越惱火。

NONE: B2 making you feel annoyed
惱人的，令人厭煩的

example: an irritating habit
煩人的習慣

C or U: C2 the feeling of being angry or annoyed, or something that makes you feel like this
› a painful or sore feeling in a part of the body

example: That kind of behaviour is sure to cause irritation.
那種行為肯定會讓人感到惱火。
Traffic noise is just one of several minor irritations (= small problems).
交通噪音只是煩人的瑣事之一。

這種殺菌乳膏適用於輕微的皮膚炎症。
The strap had rubbed against his skin and caused irritation.
皮帶擦傷了他的皮膚引起了發炎。
